# 3s-Soft UK

> One UK team for small businesses' websites, Shopify stores, Amazon and eBay listings, and the automation between them. Fixed-price plans, a UK point of contact, listed on Amazon's Service Provider Network for A+ Content and Cataloguing.

## Services
- [Shopify agency and developer for UK small businesses](https://3s-soft.co.uk/services/shopify/)
- [Amazon listing optimisation, A+ Content and brand stores](https://3s-soft.co.uk/services/amazon-marketplaces/)
- [Shopify, Amazon and eBay integration and stock sync](https://3s-soft.co.uk/services/automation/)
- [Web design and development for small businesses](https://3s-soft.co.uk/services/web-development/)
